title: Private deployment network onboarding accelerator
creator: Sofia Chen
description: Build an "accelerator" intake lane and lightweight decision fabric for Private/VPC/on-prem customer requests focused on networking, upgrades, and air-gapped constraints. The accelerator reduces manual triage time by standardizing signals, automating the initial compatibility score, and providing templated remediation bundles (staging connector recipes, packet-level checklist, and minimal proxy templates). Goal: reduce median time-to-clear-triage from ~5 business days to <= 24 hours for qualifying requests, and to provide deterministic routing to engineering/concierge lanes when manual work is required.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Automated intake form extracts network signals (eg. outbound ports, proxy type, NAT/egress topology, on-prem OS) and produces a compatibility score
A2: Score buckets defined: Green (self-serve), Amber (concierge + templated remediation), Red (eng-assisted); routing rules implemented in intake system
A3: Templates: staging-connector config, minimal bastion/proxy example, and offline package checklist published to Confluence with customer-facing copy
A4: Pilot run with 5 recent enterprise requests showing 24h triage on Green/Amber where remediation is templated
A5: Playbook includes rollback guidance, clear security guardrails, and the path for an enterprise to request an exemption

next_steps: 1) Deliver first draft of machine-readable intake schema and map fields to scoring rubric (owner: ENG-84250)
2) Build lightweight automation that maps schema -> Green/Amber/Red and integrates with support routing (owner: Product Ops)
3) Publish three remediation bundles (staging connector, minimal proxy-stub, offline install checklist) to Confluence and link from intake flow (owner: Docs)
4) Run 2-week pilot, capture time-to-triage, and collect customer feedback for copy and template gaps (owner: PM)
5) Prepare rollout comms and training for Sales/SEs and Concierge teams (owner: GTM)
communication_plan: Customer-facing copy for Green bucket will be published as a self-serve walkthrough. Amber customers receive a templated remediation packet and a single SOW-like acceptance to confirm staging window. Sales/SE training 1-pager and a recorded walkthrough will be created. Escalation path documented with contacts for Concierge and Engineering
risk_assessment: Medium: risk of underestimating unusual network topologies leading to failed installs. Mitigations: conservative scoring thresholds, clear ‘eng-assisted’ fallback, pilot with representative customers before general availability. Data leakage risk low because accelerator only collects network topology signals and does not collect app data.
outcomes_and_metrics: Primary: median time-to-clear-triage (target <= 24h for qualifying requests). Secondary: percent of requests auto-bucketed to Green, reduction in eng-assisted tickets, pilot NPS from customers for onboarding experience.
